Unlike skills, MCP servers are not inherited: a session gets only the servers listed for the folder it starts in. The description comes from the comment line directly above each server in `ruler.toml`.

|---|---|---|---|
| context7 | https://mcp.context7.com/mcp | Library and framework docs, looked up on demand. | all |
